extracted.name: Mini donuts
instruction_lines: Mix all the things and make a dough. Do not over knead.let it rest for 30 minutes
Make oil hot. Flatten the dough and cut cut small tiny donut shapes. Deep fry at low flame
You can coat with sugar and cinnamon or I used melted chocolate and some sprinkles to decorate
